text: A targeted view can expose a critical instruction.
Its limiting exception can be outside the same view.
An adjacent overlap can restore a nearby qualifier.
The source distinguishes instruction force.
Full bytes can still be stale or semantically wrong.
A compact representation changes what remains easy to retrieve.
The source’s numeric depth floors do not define benefit.
The model’s visible input is not identical to a person’s attention.
Repeated retrieval can have a cost.
An exception can change the domain of a claim rather than negate it.
A retrieval policy can follow explicit semantic dependencies.
The better unit of access depends on the next question.
Critical clause may be shown, outside the window or absent from the source.
Window size in SE37 is one, three or six clauses.
Targeted reading is an access operation; siblings include full reading and indexed retrieval.
The selected clause really is the one relevant to the current question.
Critical clause visible/exception absent is SE37 row2.
Main instruction visibility and qualifier visibility are separate axes.
The exception can precede, follow or reside in another section.
The consumer knows which separate clause qualifies the selected instruction.
One-clause overlap changes shown indices from [11] to [10,11] in row3.
Overlap can restore the exception, add irrelevant text or still miss a distant exception.
Physical adjacency differs from semantic dependency.
Qualified-span retrieval is a dependency retrieval operation; siblings include citations and linked definitions.
A clause may be mandatory, optional, conditional or descriptive.
Visibility and normative force vary independently.
A source author’s suggested next step and the user’s direct instruction can carry different authority.
The reader resolves governing instruction priority using actual context.
Current accurate, current inaccurate, stale still-applicable and stale inapplicable are possible.
Byte identity, currency and semantic validity are distinct.
Source verification includes identity checking and claim testing as different operations.
A hash comparison answers identity, not the truth of a source claim.
A view may contain one clause, a qualified span, a neighborhood or a whole document.
Compression can omit duplicates, irrelevant context or decisive exceptions.
A literal lookup and a scope-sensitive inference need different portions.
The whole corpus and a single relation have different indexing needs.
A record can meet a floor and be redundant, or have a useful partial result.
Procedural completion and demonstrated benefit are separate judgments.
The original floor is actually read rather than inferred from a title.
A dependency may complete after its parent map was first written.
A model fixture reports displayed indices; a person’s notice or comprehension requires observation.
A human can notice, overlook, misread or correctly apply a visible qualifier.
Availability, attention, interpretation and action are separate variables.
A human-effect claim has a relevant measurement rather than a generated feeling.
Cost can count requests, tokens, elapsed time or human effort.
An exact small follow-up can repair a truncation; repeated irrelevant reads may add no information.
A single missing clause and hundreds of dependencies create different strategies.
The measured cost corresponds to the real constrained resource.
The claim can hold within its condition and fail outside it.
This is restricted quantification; siblings include universal claims and existential witnesses.
Domain restriction and evidential confidence are distinct.
The qualifier is applied to the proposition it actually modifies.
A critical clause can link to an adjacent exception, a distant definition or an external premise.
Dependency depth can be zero, one or several links.
Link existence and target access are different properties.
A dependency cycle is detected rather than recursively fetched forever.
A title lookup may need one phrase; an applicability test may need its condition and exception.
A reviewer may prefer complete provenance while a current selector needs a small qualified unit.
A later query can require detail irrelevant to the current one.
The representation retains a path back to omitted source context.
